tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gnod sbyin chen po tse'u dmar po la thugs dam gnad bskul gyi tshigs bcad btsan rgod rlung dmar gyi zhags pa dgra bgegs myur 'ching zhes bya ba bzhugs so// hūm̐ mthu ldan kun khyab rdo rje nag po dpal/ /sngon tshe 'og min cho 'phrul bstan zhing du/ /rta mchog rol pas dbang bskur dam tshig phog /bka' bsgos khas blangs dran pa'i dus la babs/ /bar du rgya gar dur khrod me 'bar du/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug pad+ma kā ra'i drung / /srog gi snying po phul zhing dam la btags/ /bstan bsrung khas blangs dran pa'i dus la bab/ /phyi rabs dus su 'jam dbyangs sa paṇa dang / /chos rje bla ma sa lo sngags 'chang rje/ /yab sras brgyud par bcas pa dus kun tu/ /mchod gsol 'phrin bskul dran pa'i dus la babs/ /khyad par sngags 'chang ngag gi dbang po yis/ /bsam yas nyams gso gsar bzhengs mdzad pa'i tshe/ /spyi dang bye brag bstan pa srungs shig ces/ /gnyer gtad bka' bsgo dran pa'i dus la babs/ /da lta lnga bdo rtags tsam 'dzin nye'i dus/ /mi rnams phal cher mi dge bcu la spyod/ /khyad par bstan dgra gzugs can gzugs med 'gas/ /kha zas bzang po dug dang bsres pa ltar/ /mdzes pa'i zol gyis ngan 'gro'i g.yang sa ston/ /rnam dag bstan pa'i mjug 'di rnyog mar byas/ /bstan 'dzin rnams kyi sku tshe mdzad phrin bkul/ /dge 'dun sde rnams bshad sgrub nyams su bcug /nyes med sems can sdug bsngal rgya mtshor 'phangs/ /mi bdag bdag re'i stobs ldan 'byung po 'gas/ /ya nga'i 'phrul gyis 'gro kun rmongs su bcug /gnod sbyin tse'u dmar khyed 'khor bcas pa la/ /dngos dang brgyud pa'i sgo nas tho 'tsham shing / /yang dag bstan dang de 'dzin skyes bu la/ /log par lta ba'i gzugs can gzugs med kun/ /ma thog myur du sgrol ba'i dus la babs/ /khyod kyi mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul bsam yas kyi/ /dam nyams phyi nang gsang gsum dgra bgegs kun/

/zungs shig chings shig sgo gsum gru gu ltar/ /khug cig drongs shig kha rje dbang thang kun/ /phyes shig non cig gnyen dang stobs 'byor tshogs/ /chod cig skrod cig srog dang bsrung skyobs rnams/ /choms shig sdigs shig rigs rgyud yul 'khor bcas/ /thal ba'i rdul bzhin brlag pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /spyi dang bye brag bstan pa rin po che/ /da lta lhag ma tsam 'di mi bsrung na/ /rim gyis nub tshe bsrung bya gang yin de/ /ji ltar lags pa bdag la gsung du gsol/ /bde sdug phal cher las la rag las pas/ /sems can las dbang bcos su mi btub na/ /las smin thog tu 'bab par mi 'gyur bas/ /thugs rje'i bsrung skyobs des kyang ci zhig 'tshal/ /bstan pa bsrung zhing 'jig rten mi skyong na/ /sngon gyi khas blangs dam bcas de nyid gang / /drag shul nus pa de yang bsnun du 'gyur/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma bslus par mi 'gyur ram/ /gnas gzhi 'di tsam bsrung ba'i mthu med na/ /sngon tshe pad+mas bod kyi gtsug lag khang / /bre tsam yan chad srungs zhes bka' bsgos pa/ /me long has btab ji bzhin 'gyur ta re/ /bstan la gnod byed byung tshe mi sgrol na/ /dregs byed yongs kyi ded dpon mdzad nas su/ /stong gsum gdul ba'i mthu rtsal yod do lo/ /khro gtum stong sgra des kyang dgos pa ci/ /de bas dam rdzas mchod gtor 'di bzhes la/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i gzugs can gzugs med kyi/ /dam nyams dgra bgegs log par lta ba kun/ /khyod kyis mi thul gang yang med pas na/ /myur du drag po'i las kyis tshar gcod mdzod/ /nam mkha' stong pa la ni tshad ma 'dzugs/ /'jig rten phyi ma la ni dus ma 'debs/ /rang bzhin grub pa'i skye 'chir khus ma 'debs/ /las dbang btsan zhes tha snyad ma 'dogs par/ /bcol pa'i phrin las myur du bsgrub par mdzod/ /rgyal bstan de 'dzin bcas pa dar ba dang / /'jig rten khams 'dir bde skyid phun sum tshogs/

/khyad par mi 'gyur lhun 'grub rten brten pa/ /dge 'dun sde 'bangs bcas pa dar zhing rgyas/ /mdo sngags chos tshul dbyar mtsho lta bur 'phel/ /bsam pa'i don kun chos bzhin 'grub pa dang / /nag phyogs rtsad nas gcod pa'i phrin las mdzod// //ces dregs ldan yongs kyis ded dpon gnod sbyin tse'u dmar po la thugs dam gnad bskul gyis tshigs bcad kyi btsan rgod rlung dmar gyi zhags pa dgra bgegs myur 'ching zhes bya ba 'di yang sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos snyigs dus spyi bye brag gi bstan pa rin po che la rgyab kyis phyogs pa'i gzugs can gzugs med 'ga' re'i byed pa ngan pa mthong bas de dag myur du zhi zhing tshar gcod pa zhig yong re'i gnod sbyin chen po la gnad nas bskul ba 'di bzhin dpal bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis 'grub pa'i gtsug lag khang dang nye ba'i shar sgor zur khang du bris pa 'di la legs nyes kyi btang 'dzin gnod sbyin tse'u dmar po nyid kyis myur du shan 'byor mdzod cig/ //karma bhi ta ra bha wan+tu// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ gnod sbyin chen po tsi'u dmar po la thugs dam gnad bskul gyi tshigs bcad/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
